creator: Alexander Terp
description:
init() registers -update only when flag.Lookup finds nothing, so a pre-existing
-update is adopted instead. That is deliberate - rad already had one - but the
adoption is unchecked.

If the flag already there is a bool (goldie and cupaloy both use -update, and a
migration onto go-snap is exactly when both would be present), lookupString reads
its value as the string "true", which becomes a path substring, which matches
every snapshot file whose path contains "true". Usually that is none, so updates
silently do nothing; occasionally it is some, so updates silently apply to the
wrong files. Neither says a word.

Fix: on adoption, test the existing flag for the IsBoolFlag() marker interface and
fail loudly with what was found and what go-snap needs. A collision is rare, but
its current failure mode is invisible, which is the wrong trade for a flag that
rewrites files.
title: Adopting a foreign -update flag fails silently when types disagree
